{{ cmSummary }}
Social Agent and Blog Agent run on a schedule and write straight to this board: new cards land as Ideas, previews arrive a few seconds after the card (they are fetched from the link the agent gives), and every change is signed and listed under Activity and in each card's History.
Your part is the yes, the no, or the "almost". Move an idea to Approved and the next run picks it up. If the idea is good but needs work, open it and use Request changes: say what to change and the next run makes the changes, replies on the card and marks the request done (or ask Claude to run it now). If it is not for us, use Not for us: the card moves to Archived with your reason, and every run reads those reasons before making new ideas. Restore an archived card any time.
Social, Blog and Emails share the same columns: Ideas, Approved, Scheduled, Posted. Every card shows the date it was added; sort by Oldest added to clear out the stale ones first.
The Metricool panel is what the agent last saw there (queue, best times, KPIs, top posts). It refreshes on every run rather than live.

Add content

More images, the caption, hashtags and the rest go on the card once it exists. Open it and everything is editable.
